title: 내가 센터야
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad featuring a baritone male vocal. The arrangement centers on a warm, resonant acoustic piano playing block chords and melodic fills. A clean acoustic guitar enters with fingerstyle patterns. The bass guitar plays melodic, legato lines that emphasize the root notes. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal delivery is intimate and conversational, utilizing a chest-voice resonance with subtle vibrato on sustained notes. The production is clean with light hall reverb on the vocals and piano.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[warm acoustic piano chords]

[Verse 1]
[baritone male vocals]
현관문 열자마자 밥 먹었어 가 들린다
30년째 같은 첫마디 그게 반가웠다 [acoustic guitar enters, fingerstyle]
신발 벗고 들어서면 된장찌개 냄새가 난다
이 집은 계절이 안 바뀌는 것 같다

[Chorus]
소파에 나란히 앉았을 때 아버지 어깨가 나보다 좁았다 [melodic bass guitar enters]
어릴 때는 산이었는데
올라타면 세상이 다 보이던 어깨
